response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth across multiple domains, extensive experience with developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries), and clear leadership in open-source and workshop initiatives, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, organizational change leadership, or mobile platform expertise — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI systems, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership via open-source projects and knowledge sharing (workshops, talks)
Broad technical stack including mobile (iOS/TV), build systems, and infrastructure automation
concerns: No clear documentation of formal people management or team leadership experience
Limited evidence of mobile platform ecosystem leadership beyond iOS app maintenance
Missing demonstrated experience in driving organizational change or strategic roadmap ownership
